summary: Verified fix for reported 500 'Database error occurred.' bug on POST /api/cart. Backend API-level check + full UI e2e via preview URL confirm the size column is now stored and displayed everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: client/.env still shows VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api (not the /api same-origin the app was actually started with). Not a functional issue in this run since Vite was launched with an env override, but should be updated to '/api' or removed for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reported bug (POST /api/cart 500 due to missing `size` column) is fully fixed. API tests: POST /api/auth/guest -> 200; POST /api/cart with {productId, quantity, size:'M'} -> 200 success; GET /api/cart returns items with size field populated. UI tests (via preview URL): (1) Add to Bag without size shows 'Please select a size'. (2) Selecting M + Add to Bag succeeds, cart displays 'Size: M'. (3) Selecting L + Buy Now navigates to /checkout and Order Summary shows 'Size: L · Qty: 1'. (4) Admin login (admin@storex.com/Admin@1234) reaches /admin dashboard. Only console noise: two 401s on /api/reviews/can-review for guest users — expected/benign, unrelated to this fix.
rca of the issue: Prisma schema had `size String?` on CartItem/OrderItem but migration was never applied. Fix: new migration 20260722090000_add_item_size adds nullable `size` column, and server start now runs `prisma migrate deploy` before boot. Verified applied and functional.
